name: – Ana Catarina Mendes – After § 47 – Am 11
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2024 Rule of Law Report
part_text: 47c. Expresses deep concern about the lack of transparency of CSOs, especially regarding their funding; recalls the special report No 35/2018 by the European Court of Auditors, which highlighted the lack of transparency regarding the implementation of EU funds by CSOs; emphasises the consequent risk of money laundering and terrorist financing through non-profit organisations;
